data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Lehi', which means 'shining light', and the Latin name 'Ludovicus', which means 'famous warrior'. in_hebrew.name: לויס
in_hebrew.meaning: לויס פירושו איש לוי או שייך ללוי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לויס הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם העברי לוי, שפירושו 'לוא' או 'הוא שייך ללוי'. השם לוי הוא אחד משנים עשר שבטים של ישראל, והוא קשור לשבט הלוי שנקרא על שם לוי בן יעקב. השם לויס הוא גרסה נוצרית של השם העברי, והוא משמש כזכר וגם כשם משפחה.

in_greek.name: Λούης
in_greek.long_meaning: Λούης είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Λευί, που σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος του Λευί' ή 'που ανήκει στο Λευί'. Το όνομα Λευί είναι ένα από τα δώδεκα φύλα του Ισραήλ και συνδέεται με το φύλο των Λευιτών που ονομάστηκε από τον Λευί υιό του Ιακώβ. Το όνομα Λούης είναι μια χριστιανική εκδοχή του εβραϊκού ονόματος και χρησιμοποιείται ως αρσενικό και ως επώνυμο.

in_latin.name: Ludovicus
in_latin.long_meaning: Ludovicus est nomen christianum quod oritur ex hebraeo nomine Levi, quod significat 'homo Ludovici' aut 'Ludovicus pertinet ad Levi'. Nomen Levi est unum ex duodecim tribubus Israelis et coniungitur cum tribu Leviitarum quae a Levi filio Iacobi nuncupata est. Ludovicus est versio christiana nominis hebraici et adhibetur tamquam nomen masculinum et nomen familiae.

in_english.name: Lewis
in_english.meaning: Lewis means man of Levi or renowned warrior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lewis is of Hebrew origin, derived from the name Levi, which means 'man of Levi' or 'renowned warrior'. It is one of the twelve tribes of Israel and is associated with the tribe of Levi, named after Levi, the son of Jacob. The name Lewis has been adopted into various cultures, including English-speaking countries, where it is used as both a given name and a surname. It has been popularized by several notable historical figures, including King Louis IX of France. In Christian tradition, the name Lewis is often associated with qualities such as strength, courage, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lewis has had a significant impact on Western culture, particularly in the English-speaking world. One of the most famous bearers of the name was C.S. Lewis, a renowned Christian writer and scholar who influenced generations through his books, including the Chronicles of Narnia series. Lewis' work not only entertained and captivated audiences, but also explored profound theological and philosophical concepts.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Lewis carries a deep spiritual significance. Beyond its Hebrew and Latin roots, the name has been associated with various holy figures throughout history. St. Lewis the Great, also known as Louis IX of France, was the King of France who was famously devoted to the Catholic Church and is known for his piousness and justice. Another saint, St. Lewis of Brittany, was a fifth-century monk and bishop who helped spread Christianity in the region of Brittany, France. The name Lewis represents a connection to these saints and their virtues, conveying the sense of a shining light that leads and inspires others on their spiritual journeys.
